# DELTA features {#delta-features}

One page per comparison with DELTA features. Each feature has a summary card
and phipflow's plots:

- **Profile plot** (protein features only): prevalence of every library peptide
  along the protein, with the longest run of overlapping hit peptides shaded.
- **Scatterplot**: peptide prevalence in the two groups, the feature's peptides
  highlighted (interactive when `interactive: true` in `report_config.yml`).
- **Δ-plot**: peptide-level prevalence differences.
- **ECDF plot**: cumulative distribution of those differences.

```{r, results='asis'}
for (cmp in book$comparisons) {
  feats <- delta_features(cmp)
  if (is.null(feats) || !nrow(feats)) next
  cat(cmp_heading(cmp, 1, "delta"))
  cat(cmp_intro(cmp))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(feats))) {
    row <- feats[i, ]
    cat("\n\n## ", md_escape(feature_title(row)), " {#", feature_id(cmp, row), "}\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(feature_card(row), "\n\n")
    cat(feature_tabs(cmp, row), "\n\n")
  }
}
```
